name: pumi-scripts
description: A page in the left sidebar of everything a repository can run: the scripts of every package.json (workspaces included) and its shell scripts, each run in a terminal beside the current pane.

npm_scripts.label: Package scripts
npm_scripts.desc: List the scripts of every package.json in the repository, workspaces included.

shell_scripts.label: Shell scripts
shell_scripts.desc: List the shell scripts: the files with a shell's extension, and the ones whose #! names a shell.

show_command.label: Commands
show_command.desc: Show what each script runs, beside its name.

sort.label: Order by
sort.desc: How the packages and the directories are listed.

max_depth.label: Depth
max_depth.desc: How many directories below the repository root to look in.

extensions.label: Shell extensions
extensions.desc: Which file extensions are shell scripts, separated by commas.

shebang.label: #! files
shebang.desc: Also list files with no extension whose first line names a shell.
